title: VOOPOO PnP X Pod Tank
description:
The
VOOPOO PnP X Pod Tank
is a refillable replacement pod for the PnP X platform. Features side fill, top airflow, and a magnetic connection for easy installation.
Product Type:
Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Fill with E-Liquid)
E-Liquid Capacity:
5mL
Pack Contents:
1 Pod Tank
Coil Resistance:
Replaceable - uses PnP X coils (sold separately)
Fill Method:
Side Fill
Airflow:
Top Airflow
Compatible Devices:
VOOPOO DRAG X3, DRAG S3, DRAG S2, DRAG X2
Compatible Coils:
All PnP X coils (0.15Ω to 1.0Ω) and PnP-TW coils
Brand:
VOOPOO
⚠ Not compatible with original PnP pods (DRAG S, DRAG X, DRAG H80S, Argus Pro) or Argus Pod cartridges. PnP X is a separate platform.
Coils and e-liquid sold separately.
